mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 61 degrees at the Military Ridge State Trail. If you look to the sky tonight at 7:06 PM, you can catch the International Space Station passing from the Mount Horeb area in the west southwest toward Belleville in the south southwest, staying low near the horizon.

October is officially Community Planning Month in Verona. Mayor Diaz has issued a proclamation recognizing the Planning and Development Department for their dedication to public service and the data-driven expertise they bring to our community's future.

We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run today and more music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Looking ahead, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow or head to the Farley Center Fall Festival this Saturday.

Looking at the records from the Verona Police Department, an incident occurred on September 21 where an individual was cited for retail theft after taking candy from a store in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10:30 PM tonight.
